claude-code.description: Model ids accepted by Anthropic's Claude Code CLI on the Anthropic API (the --model flag / settings). Source: Claude Code model configuration docs plus Anthropic's current and legacy Claude model overview; provider-specific Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry ids are intentionally excluded. Newer models carry a minimum CLI version (Fable 5.2 needs v2.1.321+, Haiku 5.5 needs v2.1.293+, Sonnet 5.5 needs v2.1.284+, Opus 5.5 v2.1.280+, Fable 5.1 v2.1.257+, Opus 5 v2.1.219+, Sonnet 5 v2.1.197+, Fable 5 v2.1.170+). Claude Mythos models are excluded because they require invitation-only Project Glasswing access and are not offered in the normal model picker. Sonnet 4.5 remains accepted until its scheduled Claude API retirement on 2026-11-30.

codex.description: User-selectable model ids available through OpenAI's Codex CLI via the ChatGPT OAuth path. The CLI fetches its model catalog from chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex, which is separate from the general OpenAI API. Picker metadata comes from codex-rs/models-manager/models.json in the openai/codex repo; visibility "list" models are offered in the picker, while visibility "hide" models may remain available when named explicitly. GPT-6.2 Sol and GPT-6.2 Astra require Codex 0.166.0 or newer; GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol require Codex 0.153.0 or newer; GPT-6.1 Terra was added on 2026-10-26; GPT-6.1 Sol is in staged rollout. GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna require Codex 0.155.0 or newer. GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark retired on 2026-09-14 and is omitted. GPT-5.5 remains selectable in the picker with upgrade recommendation to GPT-6 Sol. gpt-5.2 was removed from the bundled catalog as retired. The generic API id gpt-5.6 is excluded because current Codex documentation and the bundled catalog do not establish its availability through ChatGPT sign-in. The latest bundled slug/visibility pairs were checked at commit 6c0cee50 (2026-11-17), following 126a0ee9 (2026-10-26). Models requiring separate approval and provisioning, including gpt-daybreak-blue-latest and gpt-daybreak-red-latest, are excluded, as is internal-only codex-auto-review.

antigravity.description: Model ids offered by Google Antigravity, as the union across subscription tiers. Source: https://antigravity.google/docs/models (2026-11-18). Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 thinking variants are available on Google AI Ultra and non-trial Google AI Pro subscriptions, not Free/Plus or Enterprise. Claude Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.6, and GPT-OSS-120b remain available until their announced removal on 2026-11-18. Gemini 4 Carbon, Argon, and Hydrogen are available across Pro/Ultra tiers. Only models with catalog pricing/context data are included.

google-flow.description: Model ids represented by Google Flow's web-based AI filmmaking and image-generation client. Includes the Nano Banana image family (legacy, current, 2.1, Pro, and Lite) and the Veo 3.1 and Gemini Omni Flash (v1.2 GA) video families. Availability varies by region, Google AI subscription tier, and staged rollout; this is not the complete Gemini API or Vertex AI catalog. Source: Google Flow and Gemini API documentation. Imagen models are intentionally excluded because Google has announced their shutdown on 2026-08-17.
